manifest.package_name: BBS Adaptive Efficiency - Final 3 target profiles

target_build_mapping.BBS02B: BBS02 build target ONLY for verified compatible UART/STC hardware

BBS02B.evidence: 93 point manufacturer test of unversioned BBS 48V/750W drive; user approved as BBS02B engineering proxy

BBSHD.evidence: 4 manufacturer annotated landmarks of BBSHD 48V/1000W load curve; not full 2D grid

TSDZ2.evidence: 9 shop trainer comparative measurements made on TSDZ2B (NOT TSDZ2); reference-only

manifest.integration: Use current working tree of MrHumanRebel/bbs-fw and PR #9 adaptive PAS where present; never infer BBS02B detection from filename.
manifest.safety: No automatic safety current or thermal limit increases. Data are reference, not validated hardware-specific limit tables.
